_comment: PATH -> TEST FOOTPRINT MAP for affected-test selection (see ci/select-tests.rs).
Node tags below are `group.job` keys from ci/dag/portable.json. `ci/select-tests.rs`
reads THIS file plus that DAG, maps a commit's changed files to the set of nodes those
files can affect, then closes that set over the DAG's build `deps`. The DAG remains the
single source of truth for node commands and ordering; this file only adds the
source-path -> node relation the DAG does not encode.
SAFETY MODEL (fail-safe, never fail-open):
* force_full  : any changed file matching these -> run the ENTIRE suite. Use for
files whose blast radius cannot be reasoned about locally
(build config, toolchain, the CI harness itself).
* footprints  : changed file matching `paths` -> add `nodes` (union across all
matching entries). A file may match several entries.
* ci_irrelevant: provably inert files (docs, notes). A commit is skipped ONLY when
EVERY changed file is ci_irrelevant and NONE matched a footprint or
force_full. This list is the one place a mistake can wrongly skip CI,
so keep it tight and only genuinely non-executable content.
* anything else (a path matching no rule) -> UNKNOWN -> run the ENTIRE suite.
Because a mismapped footprint can only cause MORE nodes to run (via the fail-safe
unknown/force_full defaults), the worst case of a footprint error is wasted time, not a
missed regression -- except ci_irrelevant, which is deliberately conservative.

footprints._why: Any Rust source change must re-run format, lint, and doc gates.
Core determinism engine + shared model types: linked into the hermit binary and every backend, so maximum blast radius.
The hermit CLI/library builds the binary that every e2e, backend, and mode test drives.
DBI backend plugin + its parity corpus: only the DBI build/parity path and the workspace crate suite.
SaBRe backend plugin: sabre examples plus the sabre-dependent e2e buckets.
hermit-verify is a standalone binary exercised via the workspace crate suite only.
Guest programs and e2e fixtures: run by the e2e manifest buckets and hermit integration/mode tests.
Racy guest programs used by chaos and determinism-stress buckets.
